calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-30-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840
Petitioner Kuan An Huang, aka Ankuan Huang, aka Shirley Ankuan Huang mother of minor present in court.
Petitioner Erica Debby Liu sworn and examined.
Proof of Publication on file.
Consent from other parent on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Erica Debby Liu to Erica Debbie Liu. The Court also grants the Petition for Name Change of Petitioner and mother Kuan An Huang, aka Ankuan Huang, aka Shirley Ankuan Huang to Shirley Wong.
Decree Changing Names signed in open court.
